title: Yaad aata hai tera darbar ya Allah
body:
Allah Hu
Allah Hu
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
Dour Say Kab Tak Main Dekhun Khana E Kabaa
Ab Nahi Mujh Sey Raha Jata Mere Maula
Raat Din Aankhon May Bas Yeh Khuwab Rehta Hay
Lab Pey Allah Humma Labbaik Ka Nara'a
Labbayka -Allāhummalabbayka, labbaykalā šharīka laka labbayka,
ʾinna al-ḥamda wa an-niʿmata lakawa al-mulk lāšharīkalak
Labbayka -Allāhummalabbayka,
1.Baandh Ker Miqaat Say Ehraam Aounga
Khana E Qaba Kay Phir Chakker Lagaonga
Hajr E Aswad Choom Lunga Apni Nazron Say
Hajj Pey Yeh Armaan Sarey Lay Key Jaonga
Surah E Hajj Parh Liya Qura'an May Maula
Hay Safa Marwa Mere Osaan May Maula
Jism To Mera Yahan Per Reh Gaya Lekin
Roh Hay Arfaat Kay Maidaan May Maula
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
2.Aey Khuda Aashiq Hun Main Ruqan E Yamani Ka
Aab E Kusar Ki Tarhan Zamzam Ka Hun Piyasa
Ayaten Meccay May Hai Pehli Hui Teri
Dil Minaa Per Hay Mera Qurban Aey Maula
Aankh Say Mahool Jannat Ka Nahi Dekha
Ager Tere Mehboob Ka Jalwa Nahi Dekha
Sari Duniya Dekh Ker Bhi Aesa Lagta Hay
Kuch Nahi Dekha Ager Kaba Nahi Dekha
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
3.O' Apney Bandon Say Ager Naraaz Hay Maalik
Panjetan As Ka Wasta Raazi Ho Aey Maalik
Tou Ager Chahey To Ho Asaan Her Mushkil
Raastey Hum Per Safar Key Khool Dey Maalik
Labbaik Allah Humma Labbaik
Labbaik Allah Humma Labbaik
4.Hay Takallum Muslimu Ko Dars Yeh Hajj Ka
Sab Ka Andaz E Ebadat Aik Hi Jesa
Muttahid Ho Jao Ab To Aey Musalmano
Masjid Sab Ki Alag Hay Aik Hay Kabaa
Aik Hay Kabaa, Aik Hay Kabaa
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
Yaad Ata Hay Tera Darbar, Tera Darbar Ya Allah
